raise_normal_termination: raise NormalTermination to signal normal graph termination in a Labgraph runner
catch_normal_termination: catch NormalTermination exception to handle graceful graph shutdown without error logging
create_exception_message: create an ExceptionMessage with exception bytes to pass errors between Labgraph processes
review_exception_message: review the ExceptionMessage class and its exception bytes field for inter-process error handling
summarize_normal_termination: summarize the NormalTermination exception class used for indicating normal graph termination
